summary: The root كتم (ktm) primarily means to conceal or suppress something, especially a secret. It implies keeping information hidden from others.
lane: 1 كَتَمَ ذ , aor. كَتُمَ , inf. n. كَتْمٌ [and كِتْمَانٌ ], doubly trans., He concealed, or suppressed, a secret. (Mgh.) -b2- كَتَمَ الرَّبْوَ : see a verse cited in the last paragraph of art. عور .
